source.quote: Gas is dehydrated, compressed, and delivered within the West Texas complex and to the Mi Vida plant (see below) for processing, while lean gas is delivered into Enterprise GC, L.P.'s pipeline for ultimate delivery into Energy Transfer LP's ("ET") Oasis pipeline (the "Oasis pipeline").
